{{Quote|The primary species of rathtar is native to the planet Twon Ketee. However, the subspecies known as dwarf rathtar calls Trillia home.|Ardis San Tekka's journal|<ref name="Bestiary" />}}
'''Trillia''' was an [[Expansion Region]] celestial body. It shared its name with the [[Trillia Massacre]], which saw [[dwarf rathtar]]s [[Death|kill]] and [[Diet|eat]] a large number of beings. Around [[34 ABY]], the [[Transport|cargo starship]] ''[[Sketter's Quarrel]]'' was transporting several exotic creatures the private ownership of which was illegal, including a dwarf [[rathtar]] from Trillia.

==Description==
Trillia was a celestial body<ref name="Scum and Villainy">''[[Star Wars: Scum and Villainy: Case Files on the Galaxy's Most Notorious]]''</ref> located in the [[Trillia system]] of the [[Imberlin sector]], a part of the [[Expansion Region]]<ref name="Appendix" /> and [[the Slice]].<ref name="Slice" /> It was situated within grid square P-13 of the [[Standard Galactic Grid]]<ref name="Appendix" /> and lay on<ref name="TSWGalaxy">{{StarWarsGalaxyMap}} — Based on corresponding data for [[Trillia system]]</ref> the [[Gamor Run]]<ref name="Gamor" /> [[hyperspace route]] that linked it to the [[Aridus system]] as well as the [[Mid Rim Territories]] [[space station]] [[Munt Ontdal]].<ref name="TSWGalaxy" /> Trillia was home to [[dwarf rathtar]]s, a [[subspecies]] of the [[Diet|carnivorous]] [[rathtar]] [[cephalopod]]s from<ref name="SagaOfRey">{{EncyclopediaCite|The Saga of Rey}}</ref> the [[Outer Rim Territories]]<ref name="Appendix TwonKetee">{{GalaxyMapAppendix}} — Based on corresponding data for [[Twon Ketee system]]</ref> [[planet]] [[Twon Ketee]].<ref name="SagaOfRey">{{EncyclopediaCite|The Saga of Rey}}</ref>

==History==
{{Quote|Among the exotics cataloged by the Sector Rangers were a Tralusian styanax, a sycanid from Humbarine, an Arkanian polar drake, Outer Rim worrts, and a dwarf rathtar from Trillia.|Police Commissioner Exantor Divo, ''Scum and Villainy: Case Files on the Galaxy's Most Notorious''|<ref name="Scum and Villainy" />}}
[[File:DwarfRathtar-CaseFilesOnTheGalaxysMostNotorious.jpg|thumb|right|300px|Around 34 ABY, the starship ''Sketter's Quarrel'' was transporting a dwarf rathtar (pictured in a cage) from Trillia.]]
Trillia shared its name with the [[Trillia Massacre]], an event that took place<ref name="AlienArchive">''[[Star Wars: Alien Archive]]''</ref> at some point by [[34 ABY]].<ref name="TFAdate">''[[Star Wars: Timelines]]'' dates the main events of {{Film|VII}}, during which the [[Trillia Massacre]] is mentioned, to [[34 ABY]].</ref> The event saw a large number of beings [[Death|killed]] and eaten by dwarf rathtars.<ref name="AlienArchive" />

Around 34 [['ABY-BBY' dating system|ABY]],<ref name="34 ABY">''[[Star Wars: Scum and Villainy: Case Files on the Galaxy's Most Notorious]]'' dates the discovery of the ''[[Sketter's Quarrel]]'' to 8011 ([[Coruscant reckoning calendar|C.R.C.]] date) and gives 7980 (C.R.C. date) as the [[Standard year|year]] that the [[carbon-freezing]] of [[Han Solo]] took place. As ''[[Star Wars: Timelines]]'' dates Solo's [[Carbonite|carbon]]-[[Temperature|freezing]] to [[3 ABY]], the discovery of the ''Sketter's Quarrel'' must therefore have taken place around [[34 ABY]].</ref> the [[New Republic]] [[Sector Ranger]]s discovered the [[Transport|cargo starship]] ''[[Sketter's Quarrel]]'' dead in [[Realspace|space]]. Aboard the [[Starship|vessel]], which had been destined for [[Regent]] [[Solculvis]] of<ref name="Scum and Villainy" /> the Expansion Region's<ref name="TSWGalaxy" /> [[Mol'leaj system]],<ref name="Complete">''[[Star Wars: The Complete Visual Dictionary, New Edition]]''</ref> the Rangers found several exotic creatures the private ownership of which was illegal, including a dwarf rathtar from Trillia.<ref name="Scum and Villainy" /> Later around that same [[Standard year|year]],<ref name="ScumAndVillainyDate">{{ScumAndVillainyDate}}</ref> information from the Rangers' file on the case, which mentioned the dwarf rathtar's origin, was published in the [[book]] ''[[Scum and Villainy: Case Files on the Galaxy's Most Notorious]]'', which was [[author]]ed by New Republic [[Law enforcement agency|Police]] [[Commissioner]] [[Exantor Divo]].<ref name="Scum and Villainy" /> The origin of dwarf rathtars at Trillia was also noted in the [[Ardis San Tekka's journal|journal]] of the [[Galactic Society of Creature Enthusiasts]] [[cartographer]] [[Ardis San Tekka]],<ref name="Bestiary" /> which was published at some point no earlier than [[35 ABY]].<ref name="35 ABY">{{BestiaryVol1Date}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
Trillia was introduced in the [[2018]] reference book ''[[Star Wars: Scum and Villainy: Case Files on the Galaxy's Most Notorious]]'', authored by [[Pablo Hidalgo]].<ref name="Scum and Villainy" /> "[[Star Systems of the Galaxy]]," an appendix published with the [[Star Wars Galaxy Map|''Star Wars'' Galaxy Map]] on [[StarWars.com]]<ref name="Appendix" /> on [[June 24]], [[2025]]—with both works being authored by [[Jason Fry]]<ref name="Substack">{{Substack|subdomain=jasonfry|url=p/about-that-new-star-wars-galaxy-map|text=About That New Star Wars Galaxy Map…|name=[[Jason Fry]]|username=jasonfry|date=2025-06-24}}</ref>—initially placed the Trillia [[Star system|system]] in grid square P-14 of the [[Standard Galactic Grid]], but the placement was later amended to grid square P-13<ref name="Appendix" /> in an [[October 14]], 2025 update.<ref name="SubstackUpdate">{{Substack|subdomain=jasonfry|url=p/star-wars-galaxy-map-update|text=Star Wars Galaxy Map Update|name=[[Jason Fry]]|username=jasonfry|date=2025-10-13}}</ref>
